title: Rave Master
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sixteen-year-old Haru Glory of Garage Island inherits the sacred sword Rave and the title of Rave Master from the aging Shiba. He travels the world to recover the scattered Rave stones and stop the secret society Demon Card, which uses the dark stones called Dark Bring to conquer and destroy. Companions met on the road, including Elie, a girl carrying a world-saving power, join a long adventure; Haru's long-absent father dies saving him, and in the finale Haru seems to sacrifice his life before returning a year later to live with Elie (Wikipedia; TOKYOPOP and Kodansha blurbs; MU Amnesia, World Travel, War/s).
life_message: Courage, friendship and keeping faith with those who came before can overcome a darkness bent on domination.

content.note: Sword and magic battles against Demon Card and wars across the continent, with character deaths (Kodansha blurb; MU War/s, Character Death/s, Swordsman/men; AniList Swordplay, Tragedy).
An explosion that destroyed a tenth of the world, the father's self-sacrifice and Haru's apparent death (Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy spoiler tag).
Haru and Elie's friends-to-lovers romance; light fan service (MU Friends Become Lovers, Big Breasts).
Gambling appears (MU Gambling, low votes) (to verify).

delivery.note: Villains are given backstories, such as Lucia's family curse, but the story clearly sides with Haru's band (to verify).

winners_losers: Haru and his companions defeat Demon Card and its leader Lucia; Haru's father dies for his son, and Haru returns to a peaceful life with Elie. Sympathy lies with loyalty and courage.
